mentions.name: 10-Bit Video Thumbnail Provider
mentions.description: A Windows shell extension that renders File Explorer thumbnails for 10-bit videos, which Windows does not support natively. The installer and executable are EV code signed, with plans for Microsoft Store distribution and additional similar utilities in development.
mentions.problem: Windows does not natively render thumbnails for 10-bit videos, making it tedious to open video clips one by one to find specific footage when working on projects like a short film.
mentions.audience: Filmmakers and video creators working with 10-bit camera footage
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just launched a 10-Bit Video Thumbnail Provider for Windows.

Windows does not natively support rendering thumbnails for 10-bit videos, which are commonly produced by cameras like the Sony A7IV.
